_comment: Source-owned policy for resolving the .NET runtime version represented by a merged pull request. The docs repository remains independent and always receives pull requests against main.

mainVersion.description: Runtime main develops .NET 12: eng/Versions.props declares ProductVersion 12.0.0, MajorVersion 12, MinorVersion 0, and PreReleaseVersionLabel alpha. Corroborated by upstream release/11.0. Update this policy once per yearly main-branch rollover.

releaseBranchPattern.description: Recognizes supported source release branches and extracts their .NET runtime version.

milestoneVersionPattern.description: Extracts a corroborating .NET runtime version from milestone titles such as 12.0 or 12.0-preview1.

docsMonikerPrefix.description: Builds .NET monikers such as net-12.0; use moniker blocks only where the existing dotnet/docs article supports them.

docsBaseBranch.description: docs has no release branches; every generated documentation pull request targets main.
